title: Penguin reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- penguin body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='24' ry='30' fill='#3a4a6b'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='16' ry='22' fill='#e8ecf2'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='32' r='16' fill='#3a4a6b'/>
  <!-- white face patches -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='33' rx='7' ry='8' fill='#f0f4f8'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='33' rx='7' ry='8' fill='#f0f4f8'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='32' r='3' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='32' r='3' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <!-- eye highlights -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='31' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='31' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M47 38 L50 43 L53 38 Z' fill='#f5a623'/>
  <!-- wings (holding book) -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='58' rx='7' ry='14' fill='#2e3c58' transform='rotate(-15 27 58)'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='58' rx='7' ry='14' fill='#2e3c58' transform='rotate(15 73 58)'/>
  <!-- book left page -->
  <path d='M32 55 L50 52 L50 72 L32 72 Z' fill='#e84c3d'/>
  <!-- book right page -->
  <path d='M50 52 L68 55 L68 72 L50 72 Z' fill='#e84c3d'/>
  <!-- book spine highlight -->
  <line x1='50' y1='52' x2='50' y2='72' stroke='#f7f0d8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- page lines -->
  <line x1='35' y1='58' x2='47' y2='56' stroke='#f7e9b0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='35' y1='62' x2='47' y2='60' stroke='#f7e9b0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='35' y1='66' x2='47' y2='64' stroke='#f7e9b0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='56' x2='65' y2='58' stroke='#f7e9b0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='60' x2='65' y2='62' stroke='#f7e9b0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='53' y1='64' x2='65' y2='66' stroke='#f7e9b0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='92' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#f5a623'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='92' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#f5a623'/>
  <!-- little blush cheeks -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='#f28ba8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='#f28ba8' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
